activity.role: Poet and author of Paradise Lost
activity.notes: London publication of Paradise Lost in 1667 is one representative literary milestone, not a claim that the whole poem was composed in one year. The 1674 revision and 1671 Paradise Regained / Samson Agonistes remain contextual, not separate rails. The event belongs to Restoration England, not the Commonwealth or post-1707 Great Britain. This is the English poet (1608–1674), not the Florida governor John Milton (1807–1865).
